title: Senior Resident in Broad Specialties
qualification: MD/MS in concerned specialty or DNB in Broad Specialties from eligible institutions as per NMC & Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, 2025
salary: Monthly Remuneration: Selected Senior Residents in Broad Specialties will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,500/- per month as per G.O.Ms.No.723 HM&FW (C1) Department dated 04.12.2024. || Tenure of Engagement: The Senior Resident post is a tenure position for one year only and selected candidates are required to compulsorily complete the one-year Senior Residency period as per AP DME rules. || No Claim for Permanent Appointment: The Senior Resident engagement is purely on tenure basis and does not confer any right for regularization or permanent absorption in Government Medical Colleges and Hospitals of Andhra Pradesh.
age_limit: Not more than 44 years for clinical and 49 years as on date of notification
application_fee: Application Fee for OC Candidates: Candidates belonging to Open Category (OC) have to pay an application fee of Rs. 2000/- for AP Senior Resident posts. || Application Fee for BC/SC/ST Candidates: Candidates belonging to BC, SC and ST categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/- for submitting the AP DME Senior Resident application form 2026. || Mode of Payment: The AP Senior Resident application fee must be paid through the specified online payment mode integrated with the application portal, and applications without successful fee payment will be rejected.
selection_process: Merit-Based Shortlisting: The marks obtained in the postgraduate exam (MD/MS/DNB – theory and practical) will be considered for preparing the merit list for Senior Resident posts in Broad Specialties. || Rule of Reservation: Selection will be carried out by strictly following the Rule of Reservation (RoR) as per the State and Subordinate Service rules of Andhra Pradesh, applying category-wise reservation to the available Senior Resident vacancies. || Tie-Breaker Criteria: In case two or more candidates secure the same postgraduate marks, the date of birth will be used as a tie-breaker and the elder candidate will be given preference in AP Senior Resident selection 2026. || Final Decision of Selection Committee: The selection committee reserves the right to modify conditions, alter notified posts and finalize the selection list in accordance with AP DME guidelines and Government orders.

title: Act Apprentice (various trades under Apprentices Act, 1961)
qualification: 10th class (10+2 system) with minimum 50% aggregate marks and ITI in relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT recognised institute

selection_process: Merit List Basis:Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both. || Tie-breaking:If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred. || Document Verification (DV):Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified. || Medical Fitness:Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered. || Training & Stipend:Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training. || No Job Guarantee:SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there isno guarantee of regular railway jobafter completion of apprenticeship.
